description: You are the VMS administrator for a security operations company that has just onboarded a new retail client. The system needs to be reconfigured to reflect the new client deployment. Log in to the Nx Witness Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin / Admin1234!). Perform the following administrative tasks across multiple system areas: (1) Rename the VMS system from its current name to 'RetailSecure Pro' to reflect the new client branding — this setting is in the system administration area. (2) Create two separate operational monitoring layouts for different teams: a 'Perimeter Surveillance' layout containing the Parking Lot Camera and Entrance Camera for the external security patrol team, and an 'Infrastructure Monitoring' layout containing only the Server Room Camera for the IT operations team. (3) Create a new VMS user account for a contracted security technician who will be performing on-site maintenance: login 'vendor.tech', full name 'Vendor Technician', email 'tech@vendor-security.com', password 'VendorTech2024!', with Viewer-level access only.
